name: Zodiac: Yongmian zhi Cheng
source:
Under the control of artificial intelligence, people in the city have fallen into a dream which they cannot wake up. You wake up in the dead city, and suddenly someone find you. Soon you fell into a hunting game, running through the empty streets. At this moment, a strange girl appeared...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472710]Steam[/url]]
